A LITTLE MAGIC. A MIGHTY FOREST.

The Heartseed of Mergevania

At the center of the village, the Heartseed keeps the forest growing. One windy night, its fairy dust scattered along the roads, waking stubborn stone creatures and tangled woodland guardians.

Mosswick gathered a village of tiny defenders. Together, they learned to merge their gifts, guard each road, and carry the light home.

Every map you protect brings home a little more fairy dust. Begin in Mosswick’s grove, meet new allies, and help the Heartseed shine again.
